purpose: Recover or transfer authority without duplicating substantive work. Normal continuation, predictive overlap, abrupt owner loss, and invoked-without-bootstrap-acknowledgement are distinct classes.
normal_path: On a valid same-canonical rolling wake after a committed normal close, verify newest schedule generation, provisionally rearm, reconstruct exact durable checkpoint, then claim a fresh authority epoch.

NORMAL_COMMITTED_CONTINUATION.rationale: A committed predecessor close plus verified successor schedule is intentional continuation, not failure recovery.

PREDICTIVE_PREARM_OVERLAP.rationale: A deliberately early same-canonical wake may absorb scheduler latency, but must never create concurrent substantive ownership or duplicate side effects.

ABRUPT_OWNER_LOSS.rationale: Uncommitted disappearance requires fencing before takeover; optimize independently from normal scheduler delivery.

STARTUP_ACK_MISSING.detection: MAIN expected_due + startup_watchdog grace elapsed with no generation-matched BOOT_STARTED/equivalent newer bootstrap evidence.
STARTUP_ACK_MISSING.recovery: Fixed Watchdog rearms SAME MAIN canonical to now+60s when fresh fencing permits, verifies it, then rechecks Watchdog at now+240s.
STARTUP_ACK_MISSING.rationale: Covers failures before MAIN can establish its own provisional rescue.

BOOTSTRAP_REARM_MISSING.detection: BOOT_STARTED exists but generation-matched REARM_VERIFIED/newer verified continuation is absent beyond policy grace.
BOOTSTRAP_REARM_MISSING.recovery: Fixed Watchdog rearms SAME MAIN canonical to now+60s when safe; Watchdog never continues substantive work itself.
BOOTSTRAP_REARM_MISSING.rationale: Distinguishes bootstrap entry from successful self-protection.

already_stale_fast_path.rationale: Do not add a second 120-second idle tax when predecessor was already stale for the full recovery grace.
